ValidationRule.description: Payroll Reference is required before updating maker action fields. Please select a Payroll and try again.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(Maker_Result__c), ISCHANGED(Maker_Comments__c), ISCHANGED(Maker_Result_Date_Time__c) ), ISBLANK(Payroll_Reference__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before performing any maker action, please select the Payroll Reference and confirm the action.
